Estimated block probabilities of a network histogram fit

coef.nethist.Rd

Returns the estimated block probability matrix of a fitted network histogram. Unlike fitted(), which expands the estimate to pairs of vertices, coef() returns one value per pair of blocks.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'nethist'
coef(object, type = "nethist", ...)

# S3 method for class 'multinethist'
coef(object, type = "nethist", ...)

Arguments

object

a fit returned by nethist, hnethist, or multinethist.

type

one of "nethist" (default) or "prob". "nethist" returns the network histogram, the block probabilities divided by the edge density rho_hat. "prob" returns the block probabilities.

...

currently unused.

Value

For nethist and hnethist fits, a \(k \times k\) matrix, where \(k\) is the number of blocks. For multinethist fits, a \(k \times k \times L\) array, where \(L\) is the number of layers.

Details

For an hnethist fit, the probabilities are those of the selected hybrid model, in which blocks of the same shape share one value.

See also

fitted.nethist, network_histogram-accessors

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(42)
data(polblog)
fit <- nethist(polblog)
coef(fit, type = "prob")
